newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude trades higher in U.S. aftermarket.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude trades higher in U.S. aftermarket.

text.p: North Sea Brent crude oil traded higher in the U.S. aftermarket on Friday, traders said.
Two full boats of September Brent traded at $18.65 a barrel, up 11 cents from the early IPE close of $18.54 a barrel.
A partial cargo changed hands at the same level. Two more partials traded at $18.60, traders said.
A September/October spread was done at minus six cents, down two cents from an earlier trade.
The IPE closed early on Friday as a result of power problems.
